item.title: Breaking: Livermore school board, superintendent abruptly part ways
item.description: The Livermore school board and second-year Superintendent Torie Gibson parted ways on Friday night, an abrupt conclusion to a tense time between the trustees and their top administrator over more than $14 million in ongoing budget cuts the district needs to make for next school year.
